content:
Absolutely — what kind of roleplay do you want to do?

You can tell me:
- the setting
- the characters
- the tone (romantic, dramatic, funny, serious, etc.)
- whether you want me to play one character or narrate
- any limits or topics you want avoided

If you want, I can also help you come up with a scenario.
